---

Join the AI Community of Practice for its weekly gathering starting on January 28, 2026, at 10 a.m. PST. This virtual meeting will provide a platform for members to share insights, discuss the latest trends in artificial intelligence, and collaborate on projects. Attendees can expect engaging discussions, networking opportunities, and the chance to learn from experts in the field. Whether you are a seasoned professional or just starting your journey in AI, this gathering is an excellent opportunity to expand your knowledge and connect with like-minded individuals. Don’t miss out on the chance to be part of this dynamic community.
